faq.q: Which poster sizes do you print?
faq.a: A3, A2, A1 and A0 as standard, plus custom sizes. On paper we print single-piece up to the roll width; for anything larger outdoors we recommend banner.

faq.q: Should I choose paper or vinyl?
faq.a: Paper is enough, and cheaper, for indoor boards, window backs and short-term notices. Choose self-adhesive vinyl if it will be stuck to glass or a wall, or will sit in a damp environment.
Size, quantity, stock and lead time. The unit price falls as quantity rises. Send us the size and quantity and we will quote the same day.

faq.q: Do you produce weekly campaign posters for retail chains?
faq.a: Yes. We have produced insert and poster series for Hakmar Express for years, splitting quantities and sizes by branch list and packing them branch by branch.
Standard paper and vinyl posters are ready the same day or the next day after artwork approval. Large series are scheduled according to quantity.

faq.q: Do you print posters for outdoor use?
faq.a: Vinyl posters work for short-term outdoor notices. For anything that has to survive rain, sun and wind over time we print banner or mesh — see our Banner & Mesh Printing page.
